cache_policy: Persistent local dependency/compiler caches; no remote cache restoration; fresh test execution.
scope: Representative SQLite application validation: 25 top-level Go tests with all existing subtests, selected by documented functional behavior; not comprehensive upstream CI. Deployment, acceptance, traffic and observation are unchanged.
job_count_note: Actual GitHub started_jobs definition unchanged; healthy no-retry/no-rollback counts. Never pool prior revision cost evidence.

store.TestMemoAccessScopeUsesEachMemoAudience: Memo and comment visibility follows each memo audience.
store.TestAttachmentAccessScopeFiltersBeforePa: Filter inaccessible attachments before applying LIMIT.
store.TestDeleteAttachmentsWithPolicyBatchIsAt: Reject unauthorized or missing batch targets without partial deletion.
store.TestCreateUserWithIdentityIsAtomic: Create user and linked identity atomically; roll back failed creation.

api.TestStartupFreshInstallRoundTrip: Bootstrap, sign-in and memo write/read over HTTP.
api.TestStartupPrivateInstance: Private-instance bootstrap and anonymous access restrictions.
api.TestStartupPrivateInstanceGatewayPolicy: Enforce private-instance policy through the REST gateway.

api-services.TestAuthenticatorAccessTokenV2: Validate signed access tokens; reject invalid signatures and archived users.
api-services.TestAuthenticatorPAT: Validate personal access tokens, expiry, invalid tokens and archived users.
api-services.TestCreateAndUpdateMemoRebuildsTagPayloa: Rebuild and persist tags when memo content changes.
api-services.TestListMemos: Return correct memo content, attachments, relations and reactions.
api-services.TestCreateAttachment: Validate/sniff MIME types and preserve blobs across storage-name collisions.
api-services.TestCreateAttachmentMemoPermission: Enforce owner/admin/non-owner permission for linked attachments.
api-services.TestBatchDeleteAttachments: Delete batches, deduplicate names and reject unauthorized deletion.

core-access.TestCheckMemoReadInvalidStateFailsClosed: Deny read access for invalid resource states.

core-export.TestReadAttachmentVerifiesDigest: Reject attachment data whose digest does not match the archive manifest.

filter.TestCompileContainsEscapesLikeWildcards: Escape literal percent and underscore characters in SQLite LIKE predicates.
